mutants.replacement:
receiver !==
          (isReadonly
            ? isShallow
              ? shallowReadonlyMap
              : readonlyMap
            : isShallow
              ? shallowReactiveMap
              : reactiveMap
          ).get(target)

immediateFirstRun ||
        deep ||
        forceTrigger &&
        (isMultiSource
          ? (newValue as any[]).some((v, i) => hasChanged(v, oldValue[i]))
          : hasChanged(newValue, oldValue))
